targetTexts.1: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.
targetTexts.2: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness instead of light.
targetTexts.3: Indeed, He keeps turning His hand against me all day long.
targetTexts.4: He has worn away my flesh and skin; He has shattered my bones.
targetTexts.5: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
targetTexts.6: He has made me dwell in darkness like those dead for ages.
targetTexts.7: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
targetTexts.8: Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
targetTexts.9: He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.
targetTexts.10: He is a bear lying in wait, a lion hiding in ambush.
targetTexts.11: He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces; He left me without help.
targetTexts.12: He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.
targetTexts.13: He pierced my kidneys with His arrows.
targetTexts.14: I am a laughingstock to all my people; they mock me in song all day long.
targetTexts.15: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
targetTexts.16: He has ground my teeth with gravel and trampled me in the dust.
targetTexts.17: My soul has been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
targetTexts.18: So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.”
targetTexts.19: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
targetTexts.20: Surely my soul remembers and is humbled within me.
targetTexts.21: Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope:
targetTexts.22: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
targetTexts.23: They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
targetTexts.24: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
targetTexts.25: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
targetTexts.26: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
targetTexts.27: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
targetTexts.28: Let him sit alone in silence, for the LORD has laid it upon him.
targetTexts.29: Let him bury his face in the dust—perhaps there is still hope.
targetTexts.30: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
targetTexts.31: For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
targetTexts.32: Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.
targetTexts.33: For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the sons of men.
targetTexts.34: To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
targetTexts.35: to deny a man justice before the Most High,
targetTexts.36: to subvert a man in his lawsuit—of these the Lord does not approve.
targetTexts.37: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
targetTexts.38: Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
targetTexts.39: Why should any mortal man complain, in view of his sins?
targetTexts.40: Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
targetTexts.41: Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
targetTexts.42: “We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.”
targetTexts.43: You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have killed without pity.
targetTexts.44: You have covered Yourself with a cloud that no prayer can pass through.
targetTexts.45: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
targetTexts.46: All our enemies open their mouths against us.
targetTexts.47: Panic and pitfall have come upon us—devastation and destruction.
targetTexts.48: Streams of tears flow from my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
targetTexts.49: My eyes overflow unceasingly, without relief,
targetTexts.50: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
targetTexts.51: My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
targetTexts.52: Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.
targetTexts.53: They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.
targetTexts.54: The waters flowed over my head, and I thought I was going to die.
targetTexts.55: I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
targetTexts.56: You heard my plea: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”
targetTexts.57: You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”
targetTexts.58: You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
targetTexts.59: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
targetTexts.60: You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.
targetTexts.61: O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
targetTexts.62: the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.
targetTexts.63: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
targetTexts.64: You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
targetTexts.65: Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; may Your curse be upon them!
targetTexts.66: You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.
